titulo.es: Estados Unidos considera lo de Ceuta un "incidente inaceptable" y una "flagrante violación de soberanía", pero culpa a las políticas de Sánchez

sintesis.es: El Departamento de Estado muestra solidaridad "con la gente de España y Europa", pero avisa de forma críptica: "Estamos listos para ayudar a otros aliados que consideren opciones similares contra esta amenaza" Leer
sintesis.en: Almost all of the tens of thousands of migrants who entered Spain’s enclave of Ceuta had left by Saturday, according to officials. An estimated 60,000 migrants crossed into Ceuta from neighbouring Morocco over just a few days, with at least 67 people losing their lives in the attempt. Spain has announced plans to install a 500-metre-long containment barrier along the sea border, while a majority of EU countries have called for emergency talks in an open letter to the bloc’s interior ministers.

titulo.es: New immune-blocking strategy improves interspecies organ generation
titulo.en: New immune-blocking strategy improves interspecies organ generation

sintesis.es: Xenophagocytosis is a natural immune process that limits interspecies organ generation by eliminating living donor cells, researchers at the Institute of Science Tokyo, Japan, report. By uncovering how embryonic macrophages eliminate living donor cells, the researchers developed strategies to block this response. Using this strategy, they significantly improved donor cell survival and the generation of rat pancreas in mice, bringing us one step closer to producing transplantable human organs in animals.

titulo.es: How new informatics tools help turn biodiversity data into policy insights
titulo.en: How new informatics tools help turn biodiversity data into policy insights

sintesis.es: Biodiversity loss has been among the central topics in public, policy and scientific debate for several decades. While its accelerating pace and impacts are well recognized, translating the vast amounts of biodiversity data into reliable indicators that can inform policy remains a challenge, requiring considerable time and technical effort. To help address this, the EU project B-Cubed developed automated and interoperable data pipelines that were tested via case studies.

titulo.es: FIFA retira plan de inversión privada en el Mundial y enfrenta crisis de confianza contra Infantino
titulo.en: FIFA scraps private investment plan for World Cup, faces confidence crisis against Infantino

sintesis.es: La FIFA, presidida por Gianni Infantino, retiró su proyecto FIFA Forward Enterprise que buscaba abrir la gestión comercial del Mundial y otras competiciones a inversores privados, tras una fuerte oposición de confederaciones y federaciones, encabezada por la UEFA. Pese a la retractación, la UEFA y la Concacaf declararon haber perdido la confianza en el liderazgo de Infantino, calificando la maniobra de opaca, lo que podría poner en riesgo su reelección en el Congreso de la FIFA previsto para marzo.
sintesis.en: FIFA, led by president Gianni Infantino, withdrew its FIFA Forward Enterprise plan that sought to open commercial management of the World Cup and other competitions to private investors, following strong opposition from confederations and federations, led by UEFA. Despite the reversal, UEFA and Concacaf declared they had lost confidence in Infantino's leadership, calling the move opaque, potentially jeopardizing his re-election at the FIFA Congress scheduled for March.

titulo.en: Scientists revive a powerful antibiotic that superbugs had defeated
